summary: undo_templates.py defines UNDO_TEMPLATES, a list of TemplateObject lists used by the CraftAssist TTAD dialogue generation system to represent undo intent patterns (e.g. 'undo last action', 'undo what you just built'). This file contains only data — no functions, classes, or callable APIs.
UNDO_TEMPLATES: list of TemplateObject lists representing undo intent patterns for dialogue generation in the CraftAssist Minecraft agent
